build_audio_filter_desc: build an FFmpeg audio filter string to resample audio to 48000 Hz with 2 channels
build_video_filter_desc: build an FFmpeg video filter string to scale frames to 1920x1080 with bicubic interpolation
build_filter_desc_from_packets: build an FFmpeg filter string from AudioPackets or VideoPackets with automatic type dispatch
build_abuffer_desc: build an abuffer filter description from an AudioCodec for use in an FFmpeg FilterGraph
build_buffer_desc: build a buffer filter description from a VideoCodec for use in an FFmpeg FilterGraph
